# About the Library Versions and more

- The httplib is a header-only library, so no need to build it with CMake through include path. 
- The present support on gcc (Ubuntu 9.4.0-1ubuntu1~20.04.2) 9.4.0
- The httplib version is 0.14.3 and it uses OpenSSL 1.1.1f  on 31 Mar 2020
- The library of this version, is prone to attacks, and needs to be patched, if given to public.
- The latest version of httplib cannot be included, bcz of compatibility issues with the current code.
